source.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)
source.epoch: ICRS/J2000 equinox; source astrometry primarily Hipparcos-2007 reduction, epoch J1991.25
source.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
source.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

galacticFrame.source: Hipparcos Catalogue vol. 1 §1.5.3 (ESA SP-1200, 1997); J2000 galactic frame constants shared by astropy and SOFA

panorama.title: The Milky Way panorama
panorama.longitudeConvention: l = 0 at the column centre, increasing leftward (sky seen from inside)
panorama.latitudeConvention: b = +90 at row 0, -90 at the last row

catalogRegistration.role: retained source record only; the photograph is registered astrometrically and owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky sampled in ICRF through the J2000 galactic frame and the anchor-registered panorama; the scene registration carries the Dimorphos pole and epoch; Solar System objects in the mosaic are capture artefacts; no Sun is baked into the cubemap
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: JPL Horizons post-impact orbit; observed pole with arbitrary display phase. DART 2022 shape, not a post-impact terrain reconstruction.
provenance.qualification: Computed Dimorphos Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the released DART v004 global shape. DRACO and LICIACube observations constrain different regions; the closed mesh also contains modeled terrain. It represents the encounter-era body, not a measured post-impact surface. Lighting uses an arbitrary display phase about the observed pole; no photographic texture or albedo is shown.
controls.summary: Shape from DART and LICIACube encounter images, including modeled terrain. It is not a post-impact map.
controls.title: SPC shape model v004

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows source-mesh radius minus a 75 m reference sphere, including the overall flattened shape. It is not height above an equipotential or a map of impact-induced change. Terrain coverage and precision follow the published encounter model. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.
controls.summary: Encounter-model height relative to a 75 m sphere. It shows the overall shape, not impact-induced changes.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Grayscale shows relative surface brightness from the DART v004 stereophotoclinometry model of the encounter-facing surface before impact. Values are modeled relative albedo, not absolute geometric albedo or a photograph. Facets with positive multi-image uncertainty cover about 31% of the source model area; the ordinary grid marks withheld coverage. Linear display scale: 0.45–1.30.
controls.summary: Grayscale shows modeled brightness before impact, not absolute albedo. Accepted facets cover about 31%; the grid marks the rest.
controls.title: SPC relative albedo model

controls.label: Slope
controls.description: Slope relative to modeled gravity, including uniform density, rotation and Didymos. This encounter-era model includes inferred terrain; it does not measure impact-driven change.
controls.title: Modeled surface slopes
